name: Payment Terms Policy
description: Standard net payment term limits allowed for vendor contracts.
requirement: Payment terms must be Net 60 days or shorter from receipt of a valid invoice.
guidance: If payment terms exceed Net 60 days (e.g. Net 90 days), flag as non-compliant unless explicit Finance approval is granted.

name: Termination Notice Policy
description: Required advance written notice for contract termination without cause.
requirement: Contract must allow termination for convenience with no more than 30 days written notice.
guidance: Notice periods exceeding 60 days or requiring immediate non-cancellable terms are non-compliant.

name: Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure Policy
description: Mutual confidentiality obligations protecting proprietary data.
requirement: Contract must contain explicit mutual confidentiality obligations surviving for at least 3 years after termination.
guidance: Missing confidentiality provisions or unilateral non-disclosure clauses favoring only one party are non-compliant.

name: Data Protection & Privacy Policy
description: Protection of personal data and security breach notification requirement.
requirement: Contract must specify data encryption, security standards, and mandatory breach notification within 72 hours.
guidance: Failure to require prompt data breach notification (within 72 hours) is a critical compliance risk.

name: Limitation of Liability Policy
description: Cap on indirect damages and overall liability risk exposure.
requirement: Contract must cap aggregate liability to no more than 2x total contract value and exclude consequential/indirect damages.
guidance: Unlimited liability provisions (except for confidentiality or gross negligence) must be flagged.

name: Standard Contract Template & Mandatory Sections Policy
description: Verification of essential mandatory contract template sections and structural completeness.
requirement: Contract must include core standard template sections: (1) Parties & Recitals/Effective Date, (2) Scope/Deliverables, (3) Payment/Fees, (4) Term & Termination, (5) Confidentiality, (6) Limitation of Liability, (7) Governing Law, and (8) Authorized Signatures Block.
guidance: Contracts missing critical structural sections or signature blocks must be marked as NON_COMPLIANT or PARTIAL.
